scripts.build: concurrently -n client,server,lean -c green,blue,yellow 'npm run build:client' 'npm run build:server' 'npm run build:lean'
scripts.start: concurrently -n client,server -c green,blue, 'npm run start:client' 'npm run start:server'
scripts.test: npm run test:lean && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: npm run test:build-game && concurrently -n app,cypress,lean -c blue,green "npm start" "cypress run" -k -s first --hide app
scripts.test:ui: concurrently -n app,cypress -c blue,green "npm start" "cypress open" -k -s first --hide app
